output.answer_markdown: Boeing states that it is involved in a number of litigation matters [1]. Its FY2022 10-K also refers to legal proceedings arising from the October 29, 2018 Lion Air Flight 610 accident and the March 10, 2019 Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 accident [2]. The passages do not describe those proceedings, their status, or whether any of them is material.
